                  omp_environment={k: (env or os.environ).get(k) for k in ['OMP_DYNAMIC','OMP_THREAD_LIMIT','OMP_MAX_ACTIVE_LEVELS','OMP_WAIT_POLICY','OMP_PROC_BIND']})

    try:
